newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan retail gasoline prices unchanged - survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan retail gasoline prices unchanged - survey.

text.p: The average price of gasoline at petrol stations throughout Japan was 106 yen per litre as of April 10, a research centre said on Wednesday.

The retail price report, published by the Oil Information Service Centre, calculates that gasoline prices at the pump have held static since November, in spite of steady increases in the wholesale prices charged by refiners to Japan's retail outlets in compensation for a weakening yen.
At current exchange rates the price level amounts to $3.18 cents per gallon. Tax accounts for about half of the price paid by Japanese drivers.
The nationwide average retail price of gas oil was 83 yen per litre ($2.49 per gallon), also unchanged since November.
The retail price of kerosene has been stable since March, at 905 yen per 18 litres. Kerosene for home heating purposes is generally sold in 18 litre units in Japan.
